protocol: 3-fold cross-validation of 400 training samples only; test labels excluded; final 100 test samples reused after initial evaluation and must not be described as untouched
score: max(mean relative error of max/avg) + 0.15 * max(worst relative error of max/avg)
earlier_family_comparisons: initial-model-selection.json and second-model-selection.json include polynomial and MLP comparisons
